lines: ① Stack dishes on the bench first.
② For the bottom rack, kneel on one knee.

caption:
Koko bends and twists for every plate she loads into the dishwasher, and her back aches by the end.

Short, repeated bend-and-twist movements can tire your back out. Hinging at the hips and facing the rack may share the load.

Hybi's tip: stack the dishes on the bench first, kneel on one knee for the bottom rack, and turn your feet so you face the rack instead of twisting. Finish with a gentle stand-up stretch.

Leg numbness or weakness, or pain that keeps getting worse, are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio 🍽️
